About — Every Brand Should Know Who’s Actually Buying

# Every brand should know who’s actually buying.

In e-commerce, the customer relationship has been hollowed out by ad networks, marketplaces, and middlemen. We’re rebuilding it.

Powering hundreds of the fastest growing brands:

## Built by the operators who hit this wall first.

Most brands process millions of orders a year without ever knowing who’s actually buying. The oldest tradition in commerce — knowing your customer — has been quietly engineered out.

We built OuterSignal to rebuild that relationship.

Our founders saw this firsthand from inside the brands they built and invested in. OuterSignal started as an internal tool to close the gap. It now powers HexClad, Jones Road, Jolie, and hundreds of leading brands.

### Leadership

#### Zach Zelner

CEO & Co-founder

Built and sold five companies before OuterSignal, including PupSocks (zero to $8M in a month) and ThreadStudio (Disney, Target, CVS). Started his first at 17 with $124.

#### Noah Friedman

Co-founder

Has spent a decade pattern-matching consumer brands as an investor and operator. Today he runs Top Shelf Ventures and convenes 2,000 founders through Uncharted.

#### Dov Quint

VP of Customer Experience

Ran 45+ Shopify storefronts as Storefronts Lead at OpenStore. Spent a decade in DTC operations before OuterSignal.

#### Donna Felix

VP of Operations

Led product and e-commerce at Vivrelle as their first tech hire. Built product earlier at Box and Glassdoor.

#### Hannah Wendt

VP of GTM Operations

Spent the last decade in e-commerce SaaS, building and scaling GTM operations at ShipBob, Popular Pays, Postscript, and Wyllo.

#### Alex Seibel

Head of Customer Experience

One of Postscript’s first ten hires as it grew to nine figures in revenue. Built and scaled two service lines from scratch and led the transition to AI-driven service.

OuterSignal — Funding, Investors & Team | Seedtable

# OuterSignal

OuterSignal sells customer intelligence software to consumer brands. It connects to a brand's commerce platform or CRM, combines each customer record with public information to build an individual profile, and uses those profiles to drive segments, VIP alerts, personalised campaigns and advertising audiences, with AI agents acting on them. The company is based in New York, is led by co-founder and chief executive Zach Zelner, and launched its product in January 2026; brands it named as customers at its Series A include AG1, HexClad, Jones Road Beauty and True Classic. In September 2026 it raised a 22 million dollar Series A co-led by Long Journey Ventures and Abstract Ventures.
